editorial.intro: Mack truck clipart ranges from early open cab vehicles to modern tractors and refuse trucks. Bulldog ornaments, bold grille lettering and varied cab designs recur across the collection. Freight loads, service equipment and waste bodies distinguish the different working scenes.
